description:
About the company
 Our client is a robotics company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Write and maintain software for robotic systems, working across the stack from low-level device code to cloud services. The role suits a generalist engineer who owns work from start to finish and sees it through to deployment on physical robots.
 What you'll do
 - Develop real-time robot control, motion planning and machine learning pipelines across several hardware platforms.
 - Build and maintain data labeling tools, perception software and compiler components for robot intelligence.
 - Work across the full robotics stack, from firmware to cloud infrastructure, on the hardest technical problems.
 - Design and ship systems alongside teammates in a close, hands-on engineering group.
 - Travel to customer sites to install software and verify that it performs as intended on real robots.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Track record of shipping production software from start to finish, such as deploying robots at a robotics vendor, on an autonomous vehicle team, or at a large technology company.
 - History of owning a product or engineering result from beginning to end.
 - Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, robotics or a related engineering discipline.
 - Background in a quick-paced startup or a robotics group where engineers carry significant responsibility.
 - Excellent programming fundamentals, with strong Python skills.
 - Practical experience building production code for robots as a versatile engineer rather than a narrow specialist.
 Bonus points
 - Knowledge of how whole robotic systems fit together, including connecting hardware and software.
 - TypeScript or React experience.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 130,000 to 180,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Watertown, MA, United States
 - On-site
 - 5 days in-office per week
 - Full-time
